Help.ME

⌨️ KEYBOARD CONTROLS

WASD / Arrows: Move & Drive

SPACE: Fire Weapon

E: Interact / Enter & Exit Car

F: Use Transition Point (Enter Building)

M: Open/Close Map

P: Open/Close Phone

Q: Toggle Auto-Drive (In Car)

H: Use Stim Pack (Heal)

B: Back / Close Menu

🗺️ NAVIGATION

Double-Click Map: Set destination marker

Long-Press Map: Set destination (touch)

Auto-Drive + Marker: Car follows route to destination

👻 STEALTH & COMBAT

Visibility: Watch the "HIDDEN" indicator. Standing in light makes you easier to spot.

Night Vision: Click the Eye icon (bottom right) to see in dark areas.

Flit (⚡): Dash through enemies to escape.

🚗 VEHICLES

Ownership: You can hijack any car, but your personal vehicle is marked yellow.

Auto-Drive: While driving, press 'Q' or the HUD button to let the AI drive you to a safe lane.

Delivery: Use the Car.ME app to summon your car to your location.
